ideas.title: The Web of Deceit: Uncovering the Depth of Minnesota's Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota, exploring connections between entities and individuals involved
questions: Who are the key players involved?
How deep does the fraud go?
What are the implications for Minnesota's children and families?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and bring attention to the need for accountability in Minnesota's child care programs

ideas.title: Protests and Controversy: The Aftermath of the ICE Shooting in Minneapolis
ideas.description: This story would examine the protests and controversy surrounding the ICE shooting in Minneapolis, exploring the impact on the community and law enforcement
questions: How has the community been affected?
What are the implications for law enforcement?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on the complexities of the ICE shooting and its aftermath, highlighting the need for transparency and accountability
